defense_news.title: The US Army is back in the jungle. Panamanians are showing soldiers the way.
defense_news.summary: Panamanian service members have trained, lived — and in some cases, fought — in the jungle. Now, they are teaching U.S. service members.

defense_news.title: Twenty-Six Defense unveils new soldier-worn tech
defense_news.summary: The defense firm formerly known as Elbit America introduced Primex, a headset designed with night vision and augmented reality capabilities.

defense_news.title: Italy eyes MBDA armaments for new Italo-Turkish drone
defense_news.summary: The Italian air force is due to acquire six of the drones, which are derived from Baykar’s TB-3 and are being assembled in Italy by LBA Systems.

defense_news.title: US Army creates robotics technician job to focus on drone warfare
defense_news.summary: As experts in autonomous warfare, U.S. Army robotics technicians will advise commanders on how best to deploy autonomous systems during operations.
